query: SELECT u.openId, u.name, u.primaryAnimalId, ao.animalId, ao.status, a.name as animal_name, a.slug FROM users u LEFT JOIN animalOwnerships ao ON u.openId = ao.ownerOpenId LEFT JOIN animals a ON ao.animalId = a.id ORDER BY u.openId, ao.animalId;
